Flowfin

description: Flowfin is a set of Jellyfin plugins, and this is the page that
  says what each of them is and what state it is in.

Flowfin is a set of Jellyfin plugins for a server somebody else runs.

The table below is the whole list, and it is rendered from the roster rather
than written here. Adding a plugin is a row in that file; nothing on this page
has to be edited for it to appear, and nothing here can say a different thing
about a plugin from what the roster says.

What a state word declares is what is true before anything is published. It is
the floor rather than the answer, because whether a plugin ships is a fact about
published releases and not an opinion a row may hold.

This file carries the title, the sentence a search result shows and the
paragraphs above the table. What it may not carry is a claim about whether
something is available: that is a value the build reads, so the page cannot go
on saying it after it has stopped being true.
